name: aurelian-lite
description: Aurelian Lite - structured, offline cyber risk analysis (EBIOS RM) in a single portable HTML file

scripts.test:audit: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/audit && esbuild src/domain/audit.ts src/profile/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/audit --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && MOD_A=node_modules/.cache/audit/domain/audit.mjs MOD_S=node_modules/.cache/audit/profile/index.mjs node scripts/audit-test.mjs

scripts.test:list: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/list && esbuild src/domain/listimport.ts src/domain/catalogimport.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/list --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && MOD_L=node_modules/.cache/list/listimport.mjs MOD_CI=node_modules/.cache/list/catalogimport.mjs node scripts/listimport-test.mjs
scripts.test:quant: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/quant && esbuild src/domain/quantModel.ts src/domain/montecarlo.ts src/domain/taxonomy.ts src/domain/treatment.ts src/domain/calibration.ts src/domain/demand.ts src/domain/frequency.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/quant --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && MOD_Q=node_modules/.cache/quant/quantModel.mjs MOD_MC=node_modules/.cache/quant/montecarlo.mjs MOD_TAX=node_modules/.cache/quant/taxonomy.mjs MOD_T=node_modules/.cache/quant/treatment.mjs MOD_CAL=node_modules/.cache/quant/calibration.mjs MOD_D=node_modules/.cache/quant/demand.mjs MOD_F=node_modules/.cache/quant/frequency.mjs node scripts/quant-test.mjs
scripts.test:report: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/report && esbuild src/domain/clipboard.ts src/profile/index.ts src/profile/ebios/sample.ts --bundle --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/report --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=error && MOD_R=node_modules/.cache/report/domain/clipboard.mjs MOD_P=node_modules/.cache/report/profile/index.mjs MOD_S=node_modules/.cache/report/profile/ebios/sample.mjs node scripts/report-test.mjs

scripts.test:words: rm -rf node_modules/.cache/words && esbuild src/profile/index.ts src/domain/lint.ts src/profile/ebios/sample.ts src/domain/words.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --outdir=node_modules/.cache/words --out-extension:.js=.mjs --define:import.meta.env={\"VITE_LLM\":\"1\"} --log-level=error && MOD_P=node_modules/.cache/words/profile/index.mjs MOD_L=node_modules/.cache/words/domain/lint.mjs MOD_S=node_modules/.cache/words/profile/ebios/sample.mjs MOD_W=node_modules/.cache/words/domain/words.mjs node scripts/words-test.mjs
